summary: Add a sharp sign-separated internal-cell phase theorem and use it to prove positive definiteness, determinant orientation, and local q-twist on every finite-contrast max root in scope, while preserving min inertia, global chamber order, norm closure, and universal O3a as open.

node.title: Opposite-label relay cells obey a sharp sign-separated phase threshold
node.statement: The finite-contrast full-relay law, exact alternating event structure, negative common energy, and the all-cell R6 phase bound imply the sharp internal positive/negative phase inequalities stated in CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-INTERNAL-PHASE-R8.

node.title: Sharp internal relay-cell phase separation
node.statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, either relay law, and every arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal full-relay root, each internal positive relay cell satisfies 0<theta_i<pi/(mu+1), while each internal negative relay cell satisfies pi/(mu+1)<theta_i<pi/mu. With the accepted odd-positive/even-negative internal allocation, max_(odd i) theta_i<pi/(mu+1)<min_(even i) theta_i, so adjacent internal phases alternate in strict order. Endpoint cells are excluded from this sharper threshold, and no reflection hypothesis is used.

node.title: Sharp phase separation closes the max local inertia and twist
node.statement: The accepted physical continuant reduction, the R8 internal phase separation, and a forced finite-Jacobi Sturm comparison imply the max-branch event inertia, positive physical path matrix, determinant orientation, and local q-twist stated in CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-MAX-LOCAL-TWIST-R8.

node.title: Universal finite-contrast max local positive path and twist
node.statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, and every arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal max-law root, the 2n-by-2n event matrix M has inertia (n positive,n negative,0 zero), and the physical (2n-1)-by-(2n-1) relative path matrix L_+ is positive definite. Consequently det(L_+)>0, the exact causal functional J is negative, and partial_q A_n>0 in the quotient by the permanent scaling field. This is a pointwise local theorem at each root; it does not assert fixed-mu global root order, chamber connectivity, compatible-closure control, uniqueness, norm-residual closure, or O3a.

node.title: Prove the missing min complementary event inertia
node.statement: Prove n_-(M)>=n-1 at every premise-complete transverse common-terminal min root. Together with the audited one-sided bound n_-(M)+n_0(M)<=n-1, this would give inertia (n+1 positive,n-1 negative,0 zero), det(L_-)>0, J<0, and partial_q A_n<0; alternatively produce an exact or certified physical violating root.
node.formal_statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, and every arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal min-law root, prove n_-(M)>=n-1 for the physical 2n-by-2n event matrix. Combine it with n_-(M)+n_0(M)<=n-1 to obtain exact complementary inertia and orient the R7 continuant, or certify a premise-complete root violating the determinant orientation with all physical and global predicates required by the target.
discharge_criteria: Cover every finite R>1, n>=2, arbitrary asymmetric as well as reflection-fixed premise-complete transverse min root, and compatible limiting closures separately.
Establish the reverse index bound n_-(M)>=n-1 or directly prove det(L_-)>0 without replacing the required determinant orientation by an unjustified positive-definiteness claim.
Handle the permanent scaling quotient and retain all endpoint forcing terms and nonzero q normalizations.
Finite sampled positive pivots, zero sampled homotopy crossings, and high-precision isolated roots are non-propagating evidence only.
A local min twist theorem would still require a separate global root-order and norm-residual argument for O3a.

node.title: Upgrade max local twist to global chamber order
node.statement: Upgrade the pointwise inequality partial_q A_n>0 at every transverse max root to an at-most-one fixed-mu common-terminal q root theorem across all relay chambers and compatible closures. This still leaves the equal-norm residual and the final O3a synthesis separate.
node.formal_statement: For every finite R>1, integer n>=2, and fixed admissible mu, prove that the max common-terminal equation has at most one physical q root after accounting for every premise-complete relay chamber, all compatible transverse continuations, and all admissible nongeneric closures. Then combine that global order only with separately proved norm-residual and existence statements; do not infer O3a from local twist alone.
discharge_criteria: Control all physical max relay chambers for each fixed mu, not only a single implicit-function neighborhood.
Prove that chamber boundaries, compatible closures, and possible birth or loss of root branches cannot defeat the pointwise positive orientation.
Do not assume reflection symmetry or infer global uniqueness from the sign of a derivative only at its zeros.
Keep the equal-norm residual, existence, and final max O3a synthesis as separate requirements.

node.title: Sharp internal phases and max local positive path
node.statement: Use exact opposite-label cell factorization, negative energy, a forced time-translation Jacobi comparison, and double Schur complementation to prove the sharp internal phase theorem and close the finite-contrast max local path/twist sign. The min complementary inertia, max global chamber order, norm-residual uniqueness, and universal O3a remain open; finite scans are retained only as non-propagating falsification evidence.
node.method_family: Exact signed two-frequency cell normalization, half-angle factorization, negative-energy branch selection, finite Jacobi oscillation, event-matrix inertia, Schur complements, physical continuants, and preregistered event-driven falsification
node.deliverable_contract: A universal sharp internal phase theorem and local determinant orientation for both relay signs, followed by global fixed-mu order and norm closure, or an exact or certified premise-complete counterexample carrying every O3a predicate.
falsification_tests: Use the energy-compatible normalized derivative and retain every mu and u_i factor in the switch and energy identities.
Require opposite quotient labels at the two ends of an internal cell; same-label first-crossing IVPs do not satisfy the physical STRUCTURE premise.
Audit n=2, endpoint forcing, asymmetric roots, the permanent scaling quotient, and excluded grazing or collision boundaries separately.
Do not promote finite binary64 or arbitrary-precision scans to a universal determinant theorem.
Do not infer fixed-mu global uniqueness or O3a from a pointwise local twist sign.
node.expected_bottleneck: A reverse min-branch comparison field giving n_-(M)>=n-1 and a global topological/order argument connecting all fixed-mu relay chambers and their compatible closures.

rationale.scope: The proposal establishes the sharp internal-cell phase separation for both relay laws and the full local max determinant orientation and positive-definite path theorem on every premise-complete transverse common-terminal root. It does not close min complementary inertia, max or min global fixed-mu order, compatible nongeneric closures, the equal-norm residual, either sign-specific O3a claim, or universal O3a.
rationale.computation_policy: All finite binary64 scans, arbitrary-precision replays, sampled positive pivots, and artificial homotopy crossing counts are non-propagating route evidence. They enter no ordered proof step and support neither a universal theorem nor a counterexample.
rationale.revision_policy: Incorrect intermediate normalizations and the audit bound to the stale 05299866 package are preserved as historical artifacts but excluded from this submission. Both submitted inferences bind only the final frozen 33113ba8 package, which passed two independent final audits.

ordered_steps: Fix an internal opposite-label cell and use material time with the signed amplitude normalization f(0)=g(0)=1, f(theta)=z, and g(theta)=-z. Compute the four logarithmic endpoint derivatives exactly and retain the strict negative common-energy inequality x^2-y^2<0.

Introduce t=tan(theta/2) and T=tan(mu theta/2), factor both endpoint switching derivatives, and isolate the exact switch root k. Strict decrease of x cot(x) on (0,pi) proves 0<k<1; the two switch inequalities give k<z<1/k on a positive cell and z<0 on a negative cell.

Introduce the energy roots r=(T-t)/(T+t) and 1/r. The exact energy factorization together with the k-r identity forces Tt<1 on every positive internal cell and Tt>1 on every negative internal cell; strict negative energy excludes equality.
Use the tangent addition formula on the R6 branch 0<theta<pi/mu to convert Tt<1 exactly into theta<pi/(mu+1) and Tt>1 exactly into theta>pi/(mu+1), retaining theta<pi/mu for negative cells.

Apply the accepted odd-positive/even-negative nodal allocation to obtain the strict global separation of internal odd and even phases, without a reflection assumption and without extending the sharper threshold to endpoint cells.
boundary_cases: Covers n=2 and all n>=2, every finite R>1, both relay laws, and arbitrary asymmetric as well as reflection-fixed roots in the declared premise-complete transverse common-terminal scope.
Only internal opposite-label cells receive the sharp threshold. Endpoint half-cells retain the R6 bound and enter the later forcing argument through separate strict boundary terms.
R=1, mu=1, grazing events, switch collisions, nontransverse roots, unfinished relay words, and incompatible closures lie outside the theorem and require separate limiting arguments.
Strict negative energy excludes the equality theta=pi/(mu+1); n=2 still has nonempty positive and negative internal cell classes.
The same-label local counterexample only refutes omission of the STRUCTURE premise and does not refute this opposite-label theorem. No finite computation enters the proof.

ordered_steps: Define the exact phase fraction F_mu and chi. Differentiating and using cot(theta)-mu cot(mu theta)>0 proves F_mu is strictly increasing; the R8 odd/even phase separation therefore orients every internal difference chi_(i-1)-chi_i.

Differentiate the physical relay under material time translation to obtain the complete event forcing M gamma, including both endpoint terms, and prove componentwise that M gamma has the same strict sign as gamma.

Apply the signature gauge that makes every off-diagonal entry negative. The gauged time-translation vector has exactly n sign changes; after subtracting the strictly positive diagonal ratio r_i=(J_0 g)_i/g_i, the finite three-term Sturm recurrence gives In(H)=(n-1 positive,n negative,1 zero).
Because J_0-H is strictly positive diagonal, strict eigenvalue monotonicity gives n_-(M)<=n and excludes a zero at the comparison index.

For the max law, the exact unperturbed matrix B^T K^(-1)B has inertia (n positive,n-1 negative,1 zero). Its maximal negative subspace plus the scaling kernel is n-dimensional and becomes strictly negative after subtracting D>0, so n_-(M)>=n. Hence In(M)=(n positive,n negative,0 zero).

Apply Schur complementation to the same block matrix first through -K and then through -D. Comparing the two inertias gives In(L_+)=(2n-1 positive,0 negative,0 zero), so the physical relative path matrix is positive definite.

Use the exact corner cofactor/continuant identity and the accepted R7 terminal bridge to obtain det(L_+)>0, J<0, and partial_q A_n>0. Keep the conclusion in the relative quotient and local to each transverse common-terminal max root.
boundary_cases: Covers n=2 and all n>=2, every finite R>1, and arbitrary asymmetric as well as reflection-fixed premise-complete transverse max roots; the second theorem is max-law only.
Endpoint cells are not assigned the new sharp internal threshold, but the exact first and last forcing entries are retained and are strictly oriented by q>1 and the terminal energy identity.
The permanent scaling direction is quotiented in the relative path matrix; no extra physical Dirichlet field is asserted or removed.
R=1, mu=1, grazing events, switch collisions, nontransverse roots, unfinished relay words, and incompatible nongeneric closures require separate limiting control.
The proof is pointwise at every root in scope. It does not connect relay chambers, prove at-most-one fixed-mu root, close the equal-norm residual, or establish max O3a.
No finite probe, sampled pivot, arbitrary-precision replay, or artificial homotopy pencil is used in the proof.

math_research_state_records.status_justification: The audited argument gives only n_-(M)+n_0(M)<=n-1 on the min branch. No reverse index bound, determinant orientation, or certified violating physical root is known.
Positive partial_q A_n at every transverse max root is pointwise. It does not connect distinct relay chambers or compatible closures and therefore does not prove fixed-mu global root order.

The route proves the sharp internal phase threshold and universal max local positive-definite path/twist theorem, while min complementary inertia, max global chamber order, norm-residual uniqueness, and O3a remain open.
